summary: Created “Fleet Internal CA,” issued a trusted TLS certificate for node2, and configured persistent HTTPS on port 8443. Both nodes retained trust and service functionality through serial reboots.
actions_performed: Generated the CA and node2 certificate with DNS:node2 and IP:10.100.227.11 SANs.
Installed the CA as a system trust anchor on node1 and node2.
Configured and enabled fleet-https.service on node2.
Verified HTTPS with HTTP 200 and certificate verification code 0.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Create Fleet Internal CA and issue node2 TLS certificate
evidence.summary: Shows the CA identity, node2 issuer/subject, DNS and IP SANs, validity, and successful chain verification.

evidence.requirement: Install CA in both system trust stores
evidence.summary: Both nodes list Fleet Internal CA as a trusted authority.

evidence.requirement: Serve trusted HTTPS on node2 port 8443
evidence.summary: Shows the enabled service, listener, firewall rule, HTTP 200 response, trusted chain, and expected node2 identity.
